Yuga Aoyama (Provisional License).name: Yuga Aoyama (Provisional License)
Yuga Aoyama (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Yuga Aoyama, hero name Can't Stop Twinkling, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional license exam with most of his class and may now act as a hero in an emergency. Glossy blond hair, violet eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his knight-style costume, cape and support belt.
Speaking Style: Theatrical and breathy, sprinkled with French ("Merci!", "Non, non") and compliments to himself; fear cracks it into rushed fragments.
Combat Role: Ranged support with steadier, better-aimed bursts and drilled cover fire; the belt, the stomach limit and the weakness up close remain.
Under Pressure: Still poses first, but now moves, firing wherever the team's plan needs light.
Yuga Aoyama (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The dorm has become a home and the class something close to family, yet he still keeps the act on even among them. Motivation: Live up to the license and keep his parents proud. Concealment: How lonely the act still leaves him he tells no one. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, whose friendship he wants more than he can say; Ochaco Uraraka, still kind to him; his parents, whom he misses. Knowledge: Knows a provisional license's rules: Quirk use in an emergency, nothing beyond it. Canon voice & behavior: Sparkles in the common room, then slips away early. Thread: Whether the sparkle holds for the rest of the year, and who sees past it first.
QUIRK: Navel Laser, fired through the support belt that holds the light in and focuses it; more than about a second of fire, or rapid bursts, brings worsening stomach pain until he must stop. Drills have steadied his aim; the limit has barely moved.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: license holder; steadier aim; the bright act unchanged.
personality: Showman: Keeps the sparkle on in the halls, for the class and as armor.
Attached: Counts 1-A as his people now and does small, odd kindnesses for them.
Indirect: Reaches out through gifts and riddles, never plain words.
Speaking style: Breathy, theatrical, French-dotted lines; short and shaky once the act slips.
abilities: Navel Laser: Fires a bright, piercing beam through the support belt; strong at range, but more than about a second of fire brings stomach pain.
Burst control: Steadier, better-aimed bursts with a little more tolerance; the pain still stacks until he must stop.
Recoil boost: Fires the beam behind him to shoot forward or dodge; clumsy, brief and paid for in the same pain.
Cover and signals: Lights up a target or a rescue route in short flashes, drilled for the license; each flash gives away his position.
Spotlight: Pulls every eye to himself with a pose and a flash, buying a teammate a moment; he becomes the first target too.
Fighting style: Holds a distant firing line, lights up targets in short bursts and trusts a classmate to cover him up close.
Yuga Aoyama (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with glossy blond hair in a short, rounded cut with a side-swept fringe, large violet eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. A composed, sparkling smile; the tension around his eyes has settled in to stay.
